4_johnny_appleseed_backscatter.title: Full circumnavigate: US seats → 400-year curves → world bounce
4_johnny_appleseed_backscatter.seat_the_US: All 50 states + DC + territories. Every incorporated place. Tag each: reported|inferred|silent, months_filed, pop_denominator, definition_bag

400y_curves.Eisner: Medieval 10-70/100k → modern ~1/100k (Europe). Factor 10-50× decline by 20th century.
400y_curves.Roth: Early US 1600s often >100/100k → ~1-5/100k by ~1790 in studied colonies.
400y_curves.US_vs_Europe_post_2000: Europe ~2/100k, US ~4-7/100k. National aggregates hide city reporting asymmetry.

4_johnny_appleseed_backscatter.rule: Curve is a PRIOR you refire toward. Actual rate seats on top with ±error. Violation = distance from seated prior, not from a medal.

Rank cities by rate without completeness tags or ±error bars

Never CERTAINTY. The pen is mightier than the sword — IF it writes. We ate it all. The silver herd is assembled.
